title: The death of Sauron
description: Long ago, at the dawn of the Second Age: in a fortress of the north Sauron proclaims himself the Orcs' new master. Adar crowns him with Morgoth's crown — points downward — and the Orcs finish it. What is left of him seeps into the rock and, over centuries, crawls back toward a body.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

title: The man on the raft
description: Reborn in the shape of a man, Sauron takes a dead traveller's royal pouch, boards a refugee ship — and survives the sea-worm that wrecks it, to drift toward a raft and Galadriel.

title: Elrond flees with the Three
description: In Lindon Galadriel confesses that Halbrand was Sauron. Gil-galad wants to use the rings anyway; Elrond, sure that they are tainted, seizes them and leaps from a waterfall.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

title: Círdan's choice
description: Elrond brings the rings to Círdan the Shipwright, eldest of the Elves, who agrees to drop them into the deepest sea — until he looks at them.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

title: The light returns to Lindon
description: As the last leaves fall from the great tree, Círdan arrives wearing Narya. Gil-galad takes Vilya, Galadriel takes Nenya, and the tree bursts into bloom. Elrond alone will not trust them.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

title: Lost in Rhûn
description: The Stranger and Nori wander the wastes of Rhûn in circles, starving — until Poppy catches up with Sadoc's old maps, and a Harfoot walking-song points the way.

title: A prisoner in Mordor
description: Halbrand lets Adar's Orcs take him. He tells Adar that Sauron has returned and sits in Eregion among the Elves — and offers to deliver him, if Adar will bring his army. Waldreg, who tormented him in his cell, does not outlive his release.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com
